summary.motive: Double-cover the stick deliberately so the naked swing constraint runs free behind over-committed flat defenders.
summary.whyItWorks: Quarters rules force the flat player to sink with the stick; the running back's swing path occupies precisely the grass both defenders abandoned.
summary.failureMode: The flat defender keeps outside-in leverage on the running back instead of sinking with the stick, taking away the constraint at its origin.

beats.title: 1. The Trips Distribution
beats.text: Trips floods the weak side with three simultaneous threats: a seam clearout, a five-yard stick, and a bubble fake. The flat defender must pick one immediately.

beats.title: 2. The Stick Bites Both Defenders
beats.text: Both the nickel and the flat linebacker sink on the stick route, doubling a five-yard throw that was never meant to be caught.

beats.title: 3. The Naked Swing Appears
beats.text: With every defender staring at the trips distribution, the running back swings out of the backfield completely uncovered behind their shoulders.

beats.title: 4. The Constraint Pays
beats.text: The quarterback flips to the naked swing, the top of trips escorts the first tackler, and the conversion is made in space against zero defenders.

relations.tell: The running back never blocks — he releases across the backfield on his first step, which no true stick play does.
